title: SKE Bar Blue Razz Lemonade Prefilled Vape Pod
description: Designed for the SKE Bar Prefilled Pod Kit, this Blue Razz Lemonade pod combines rich berry notes with a sharp citrus kick. You'll get the bold, sweet taste of Blue Raspberry alongside fizzy Lemonade zest, finished off with a bright, tangy exhale. Filled with 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt and mesh coil tech, this pod is built for smooth, flavour-packed MTL vaping. Please Note: These are pods ONLY and the Battery is not included.
